symptom: HTTP 504 Gateway Timeout during checkout spikes
root_cause: PostgreSQL connection pool maxed out at 50 connections due to unclosed sessions
resolution: Increased pool limit to 250 in pgbouncer and enabled connection recycling timeout

symptom: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable after deployment v2.4.1
root_cause: Missing JWT_SECRET environment variable in production Kubernetes ConfigMap
resolution: Patched secret configuration in helm chart values and restarted auth pods
